note: Ground heights across the resort, in metres above the level of the middle pool. From Dave (2026-10-13): the Pintor Dalí side is about half a metre higher, and the change is mostly at short ramps on the lanes. Coordinates are turned-frame metres (sea downward).

evidence.cervantes: photo:IMG_2262.jpg, IMG_2265.jpg: tiled ramp at Elena, foot at x -162
evidence.eva: photo:IMG_2333.jpg, IMG_2248.jpg: three stone steps with a tiled ramp beside them climb out of the middle pool courtyard onto Calle Eva (IMG_2333); the foot is the bottom step. IMG_2248, taken a few metres further west, looks along the upper lane towards the Dalí car park, level or gently rising.
evidence.elsewhere: guessed: the line joining the photographed rises, kept west of the north pool lawn, and 20 m in from Dalí south of Eva
evidence.middlePoolWest: photo:IMG_2332.jpg, IMG_2331.jpg: the path between the raised planter and the pool fence is at pool level and rises at its north end to a pergola gate, with white steps up by the planter's north end; so the foot follows the back of the planter from there to the Eva steps. The north end is medium confidence.

localRuns.evidence: photo:IMG_2286.jpg, IMG_2262.jpg: three shallow steps beside the smooth ramp, starting about one tile up from the foot drain, take the whole rise; each step stands a little above the ramp beside it, so the ramp climbs the same 0.5 m over a few metres, not 7
localRuns.trust: Run estimated from tile and tread sizes in the photos (about 0.4 m tiles, 0.5 m treads with their nosings): about the shortest run that keeps every tread above the ramp beside it (from 2.8 m), with a few centimetres to spare at the first tread. Applies only where the foot line crosses Cervantes; the rest of the line keeps the 7 m run.

localRuns.evidence: photo:IMG_2333.jpg: three stone steps (about 0.5 m) with a steep tiled ramp of 1.5-2 m beside them, then the lane climbs a little more to the gateway; IMG_2332 shows a short rise at the planter's north end.
localRuns.trust: Run from the step treads (about 0.45 m) and the ramp length judged in IMG_2333: 2.4 m is the shortest walkable run (slope 0.21) that keeps every tread above the ramp. Applies along the west side of the middle pool courtyard only.

localSurfaces.name: Dalí south · gentle flagstone approach
localSurfaces.trust: IMG_2283 shows a continuous gentle flagstone slope, flared white sides and a grooved concrete toe, not a staircase. Rise .25 m within 0.15-0.35 m photo range; run 5.61 m and width estimated. Aerial and unchanged southern registry facade constrain this bounded external approach to about 2 m; the covered passage behind it has not been traced independently and is not cut into the large registry building. Houses keep their existing datum. The approach stops outside that facade.
